title: Full support of the uniform bit distribution
statement: Let the uniform law on one bit assign probability $\tfrac{1}{2}$ to each of the two values in $\{\text{false}, \text{true}\}$. Then for every bit $b$, the probability mass assigned to $b$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: b is an arbitrary bit (Boolean value)
replaced: The uniform law on one bit has full support.
